## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The legacy-header test should be corrected because it cannot detect the defect it names; the separate complete-report test does exercise unsupported-version rejection.

## Changes
The parser now requires the exact header `REPORT v1`. The pull request adds two rejection tests.

## Important
- tests/test_report.py:11 — tests — Make the legacy-header test reach header validation — For `REPORT v1\nversion=v0`, the test passes because the input lacks `END`, before header validation runs. `rsplit("v1", 1)` changes the payload instead of the header, so the original permissive parser also passes this assertion. — With this malformed fixture, the legacy-header test provides no regression protection for the version check it claims to guard.
